name: cloudsee-drive
description: Browse, search, download, share, upload and organize your CloudSee Drive (Amazon S3) files in natural language.
long_description:
CloudSee Drive is a browser interface for Amazon S3. This extension lets Claude work with your drives directly: list them, browse and search folders, read file metadata and tags, and generate short-lived download and share links. With your permission it can also upload files, create folders, rename, move, duplicate, update metadata, restore archived (Glacier) objects, and delete files.

Because the extension runs on your own machine, `upload_file` takes a path and streams the file straight to storage — large files are uploaded in parts, with no size ceiling imposed by the conversation.

Destructive actions ask for explicit confirmation before anything changes, and an upload never overwrites an existing file: a name that is already taken gets a timestamp appended.

api_key_id.title: API key ID
api_key_id.description: From the CloudSee Drive dashboard — looks like AKIA…

api_key_secret.title: API key secret
api_key_secret.description: The matching secret. Shown only once when you create the key.

api_base_url.title: API base URL
api_base_url.description: Leave as-is unless you were told otherwise. UAT is https://drive-api-uat.cloudsee.cloud

default_bucket.title: Default drive
default_bucket.description: Optional. A drive (S3 bucket) name to use when you don't name one — saves repeating it.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: Optional. error | warn | info | debug. Use debug to record every API call for auditing (the secret is redacted).

tools.name: list_buckets
tools.description: List the drives (S3 buckets) the account can access

tools.name: browse_folder
tools.description: List the files and sub-folders inside a folder, with sorting and pagination

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Find files and folders by name keyword within a drive

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List a drive's files straight from storage, recursively

tools.name: recent_files
tools.description: List the account's most recently accessed or modified files

tools.name: get_file_metadata
tools.description: Get size, type, timestamps, storage class and other attributes for one file

tools.name: get_file_tags
tools.description: Get the S3 object tags attached to a file

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Get a short-lived pre-signed download URL for a file

tools.name: share_link
tools.description: Create a revocable CloudSee share link to a file, for a chosen number of hours

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file from this machine into a drive, in parts when it is large

tools.name: upload_status
tools.description: Check progress on a large upload that is still running in the background

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a new folder in a drive

tools.name: rename_file
tools.description: Rename a file or folder (asks for confirmation)

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or copy a file or folder to another location (a move asks for confirmation)

tools.name: duplicate_file
tools.description: Create a copy of a file in the same location

tools.name: delete_files
tools.description: Permanently delete files or folders (asks for confirmation)

tools.name: update_metadata
tools.description: Update a file's category, description, project and tags, keeping by default anything you do not send — send a field as "" to clear it, tags: [] to clear every tag, or mode "replace" to overwrite the whole state (asks for confirmation; rewrites the object in place, changing its ETag and LastModified; not available for objects larger than 8 GiB)

tools.name: restore_archived_file
tools.description: Begin restoring an archived Glacier object so it can be downloaded (asks for confirmation)

tools.name: get_version
tools.description: Report this connector's version, its tool count and the CloudSee API host it is configured against
